summary.text: Mihaela Pleșa is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 70 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mihaela Pleșa was born in Dallas, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Texas in 2006 and a graduate degree from Southern Methodist University in 2012.
Her career experience includes working as a legislative director with the Texas House of Representatives.
Pleșa took office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Scott Sanford.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as International Relations & Economic Development, Pensions, Investments and Financial Services, and Resolutions Calendars.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Republican George Flint in the general election.
